source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic view of a flat, front-on brick wall surface filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no directional sun shadows, no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Central Asian hazarbaf embossed basketweave brickwork built of narrow fired marl buff bricks (#d5ba92 to #c7a97e) and warm terracotta-rose bricks (#b95b45 to #a44935) laid in tight horizontal and vertical groups to form a repeating geometric weave of stepped lozenges and interlocking chevrons, alternate brick groups recessed by 12 mm in pale sandy alkaline lime mortar (#dfd4be), with small square turquoise-glazed ceramic plug inlays (#1e8c86) set at the centers of the diamond motifs, fine sandy clay grain and slight weathered chips on brick arrises. Full colour, matte brick with satin glazed plugs.
source.reuse: Urban Tabisti hazarbaf walls (kits/tabisti, buffbrick, 1.6 m); any Persian or Central Asian banna'i / hazarbaf brick weave
